card.name: Have/has after a subject describing change over time
card.fires_on: The helper word have or has (sometimes continue to) right after a plural or singular noun subject, in general web text about trends over years or decades, just before a verb describing change or lack of change.

modes.label: Have/has after subject
modes.description: Perfect-tense helper after a noun subject whose trend over time is described.
modes.example: standardized test scores at public schools<< have>> largely remained the same over the past decade

modes.label: Continue to
modes.description: The word to after continue, introducing an ongoing trend.

modes.description: The word and joining adjectives in a phrase like developing and least-developed.
